free.title: LITTLE ISLAND FREE SUNDAY
free.caption:
FREE · HUDSON RIVER

A park that floats on the Hudson, free until midnight.

Little Island is the best free move in Meatpacking this weekend: hills and gardens standing on giant concrete tulips over the water, skyline included. Today is also the last day of the Culture Food Pop-Up, so the park eats well one final time before September.

It runs 6AM to midnight, and walking in costs nothing all season - only the Amph shows are ticketed.

The southwest overlook at golden hour is the shot. Pair it with the High Line - the Gansevoort St entrance is 5 minutes south.

Send this to your sunset-walk person.

food.title: GRAND BAZAAR SUMMER SEND OFF
food.caption:
FOOD & MARKET · UPPER WEST SIDE

One last summer haul before September takes over.

Grand Bazaar NYC runs its Summer Send Off edition today, and it is peak Sunday on the Upper West Side: 100+ vendors of vintage, antiques, original art and artisanal treats filling 77th St at Columbus Ave from 10 to 5. It is the kind of market where the good jewelry and cameras are gone by noon, so early birds win.

Go hungry - the international food stalls are half the point.

Cross the street after and end the day under the blue whale at the Natural History Museum.

Tag your thrift-obsessed friend.

art.title: 6 SECRETS OF CENTRAL PARK
art.caption:
HIDDEN GEM · CENTRAL PARK

The most-visited park in America is still keeping secrets.

Every lamppost in Central Park is a compass: the first two digits on its base give the nearest cross street, and the last digit tells you east or west. That is secret one of six in today's cards - along with a British warship cannon that sat loaded near 107th St until 2013, and an iron drinking ladle from the 1800s still chained to a rock in the North Woods.

All six are free, self-guided, and hiding in plain sight between 65th and 107th St.

Send this to your walk-and-talk friend - then test the lamppost trick on your next crosstown shortcut.
